headline: UK September Inflation Climbs to 3.5%, Driving State Pension and Benefit Upgrades
summary: United Kingdom inflation accelerated to 3.5% in September, reaching its highest rate in nearly a year and setting the benchmark for statutory annual adjustments to the state pension and welfare benefits.
why: The UK inflation rate dictates sovereign index-linked expenditure and guides the Bank of England's interest rate trajectory.

impacts.name: United Kingdom
impacts.why: Higher inflation increases government index-linked spending obligations while compounding household purchasing power strains.
